models_evaluated: rule-based NLP triage with post-processing regression model

links.outcome: Agreement between predicted accuracy and accuracy in live EHR deployment
links.effect: Post-processing model predicted 84.2% accuracy; the first 200 live cases showed 83.5%, consistent with prediction.
links.quote: The implementation accuracy of 200 cases for the first 3 months was consistent with our prediction at 83.5%, which concluded that the improvement over ML models (p-value = 0.018) was statistically significant at 95% significance level.

unlisted_practices: Iterative refinement of rule-based NLP triage rules with clinician knowledge and expert review of cases
Rule-based knowledge-driven approach versus ML for referral triage

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively implements an NLP/rule-based triage model integrated into an EHR workflow for pain medicine scheduling, evaluating its real-time implementation accuracy over 3 months.
